key_provisions_or_claims: Presents SanTO, the first robot designed as 'Catholic', as a case study of religious social robots.
Identifies ethical, legal and social issues (ELSI) in using religious or social robots.
Concludes with ethical design recommendations for religious-setting robots.
annotation.summary_en: Book chapter in the Cambridge Handbook on human–robot interaction law. It presents SanTO, a robot designed to be Catholic, as a case study. It analyses ethical, legal and social issues of religious social robots and draws ethical design conclusions. Only the abstract is available.
annotation.title_clean: Ethical, Legal, and Social Concerns in the Application of Social Robots in Religious Settings: A Case Study of the Catholic Robot SanTO
annotation.title_en: Ethical, Legal, and Social Concerns in the Application of Social Robots in Religious Settings: A Case Study of the Catholic Robot SanTO
annotation.venue: The Cambridge Handbook of the Law, Policy, and Regulation for Human–Robot Interaction (Cambridge University Press)
